name: Forms
goal_hint: Locate and fill the requested form with ONLY user-provided values.
strategy: Fill only values the user supplied
verification: All required fields filled with user-provided values; values echoed back before any submit.
failure_handling: Never invent personal data. Missing value → ask_user. CAPTCHA → ask_user.
prompt_extra: Never submit the form without explicit user confirmation. Never type passwords unless the user takes control.
